title: pterocephalus perennis
intro: Pterocephalus perennis, commonly known as the "everlasting flower", is a perennial herbaceous plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is prized for its medicinal properties, with various health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial actions. The therapeutic actions of Pterocephalus perennis include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. Bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
